name: Can I replace my old tub with a walk-in shower instead during a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my old tub with a walk-in shower instead during a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing an old tub with a walk-in shower is a common request in luxury bathroom renovations, especially for homeowners seeking a more accessible or spa-like experience. This transformation can significantly enhance functionality and beauty. Our design-build team can expertly convert your existing tub space into a spacious walk-in shower with features like frameless glass enclosures, rainfall showerheads, and custom tile work. This decision involves considerations for plumbing, waterproofing, and overall bathroom layout to ensure a seamless and high-value transformation that aligns with your lifestyle needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can replace an old tub with a walk-in shower, a common luxury bathroom renovation that enhances functionality and accessibility, managed by AKN Design Group.
